title: docs: list content_blocked in the API error table
author: greysonmiller67-lang

gist.summary: Added `400 content_blocked` to the API error table generator alongside the existing `422 content_policy_violation` moderation error. The API already emits `content_blocked`, and the safety guide already documents it; the generated table omitted it. `APIDOCS.md` was not changed in this PR.
